title: Spectral Haar Binarizer: Compact Boolean Contrast Representations for Hyperspectral Classification
abstract: arXiv:2610.41478v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Tsetlin Machines offer an interpretable, hardware-friendly alternative to conventional machine learning models, but applying them to continuous hyperspectral measurements requires converting spectral signals into Boolean representations. Standard binarisation methods typically discretise each spectral band independently, potentially discarding important relationships between neighbouring wavelengths. In this paper, we introduce the Spectral Haar Binarizer (SHB), a contrast-based spectral representation method that constructs Boolean predicates from differences between selected spectral intervals. Inspired by Haar-like contrast features, the method uses an AdaBoost-style selection procedure to obtain a compact set of discriminative spectral predicates. translated_title: 谱Haar二值化器：面向高光谱分类的紧凑布尔对比表示
translated_abstract: Tsetlin机器为传统机器学习模型提供了一种可解释且对硬件友好的替代方案，但将其应用于连续的高光谱测量数据时，需要将光谱信号转换为布尔表示。标准的二值化方法通常对每个光谱波段独立地进行离散化，这可能丢失相邻波长之间的重要关系。在本文中，我们提出了谱Haar二值化器（SHB），这是一种基于对比的光谱表示方法，通过所选光谱区间之间的差异来构建布尔谓词。受Haar类对比特征的启发，该方法采用AdaBoost风格的选择过程，获得一组紧凑且具有判别力的光谱谓词。我们在五个异构的高光谱数据集上评估了SHB，这些数据集涵盖法医血液检测、农业与城市遥感以及雨林树种分类。
tldr: 提出谱Haar二值化器（SHB），通过构建光谱区间差异型布尔谓词并利用AdaBoost风格的选择获得紧凑表示，从而克服传统逐波段独立二值化丢失相邻波长关系的缺陷，提升Tsetlin机器在多类高光谱分类任务中的表现。
